n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())

N = 505
blok = [0] * N
sum_arr = [0] * N
binom = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
dp = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
ways = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]

def add_mod(a, b):
    a += b
    if a >= mod:
        a -= mod
    return a

def mul_mod(a, b):
    return (a * b) % mod

def c2(x):
    return ((x * (x + 1)) // 2) % mod

# Precompute binomial coefficients
binom[0][0] = 1
for i in range(1, N):
    binom[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        binom[i][j] = (binom[i - 1][j] + binom[i - 1][j - 1]) ) % mod

# Calculate blok and sum arrays
for x in range(1, m + 1):
    for i in range(1, x + 1):
        temp1 = mul_mod(blok[i - 1], mul_mod(blok[x - i], binom[x - 1][i - 1]))
        blok[x] = add_mod(blok[x], temp1)
        temp2 = mul_mod(add_mod(c2(i - 1), c2(x - i)), temp1)
        sum_arr[x] = add_mod(sum_arr[x], temp2)
        temp3 = mul_mod(sum_arr[i - 1], mul_mod(blok[x - i], binom[x - 1][i - 1]))
        sum_arr[x] = add_mod(sum_arr[x], mul_mod(temp3, x + 1))
        temp4 = mul_mod(sum_arr[x - i], mul_mod(blok[i - 1], binom[x - 1][i - 1]))
        sum_arr[x] = add_mod(sum_arr[x], mul_mod(temp4, x + 1))
    blok[x] = mul_mod(blok[x], x + 1)

ways[0][0] = 1
for i in range(1, m + 1):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        for sz in range(1, i + 1):
            temp1 = mul_mod(ways[i - sz][j - 1], mul_mod(blok[sz], binom[m - i + sz][sz]))
            ways[i][j] = add_mod(ways[i][j], temp1)
            temp2 = mul_mod(ways[i - sz][j - 1], mul_mod(sum_arr[sz], binom[m - i + sz][sz]))
            dp[i][j] = add_mod(dp[i][j], temp2)
            temp3 = mul_mod(dp[i - sz][j - 1], mul_mod(blok[sz], binom[m - i + sz][sz]))
            dp[i][j] = add_mod(dp[i][j], temp3)

ans = 0
for i in range(1, m + 1):
    zero = n - m
    lef = zero - (i - 1)
    if lef >= 0:
        temp = mul_mod(dp[m][i], binom[i + lef][lef])
        ans = add_mod(ans, temp)

print(ans)
</translated_code>
